changes: Additive mention_count field in existing server unread-summary API. Counts persisted direct mentions and current-role/default-role mentions after the timestamp/id read cursor, deduplicated per message and excluding the reader's own messages. Does not inspect encrypted message bodies or page the notification inbox.
Existing read-state service filters every result through current ViewChannel and ReadMessages permissions. Server-scoped handler/membership middleware is unchanged.

Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Up/Down select previous/next unread mention server channel through the shared registry, help and custom assignment editor. Uses the same bounded, abortable snapshot navigation path. Missing mention_count on an older backend yields an error, not a false no-mentions result.

Message service delete now uses existing MessageTxRunner to preserve/decrement read state, delete persisted direct/role mentions and notifications, and delete the message as one transaction. File cleanup and broadcasts remain after successful commit.

PrepareMessageDeletion uses timestamp/id comparisons before removing the parent row. A deleted read anchor moves to its predecessor without lowering the reader's unread count; deleting a genuinely unread message lowers it once. Transaction rollback restores cursor, count, mentions and message.
